audit_kind: s3a composer batch A, ur (RTL), fresh independent audit of uncommitted bytes on disk

auditor.actual_model_source: session header anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5; no provider fallback

method.icu: every en and ur value parsed with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser; argument names, plural/select option keys, number skeletons and pound usage compared per key (0 differences); ur plural categories one/other (CLDR) on all 4 plural messages
method.render: intl-messageformat locale ur at counts 0,1,2,5,11,21,100 for stopped_children, stopped_jobs, removal_many; stopped_both at 7 count pairs; fast_mode.dial_differs at all 4 on/off pairs
method.hygiene: NFC, no edge/double space, no non-ASCII whitespace, no bidi/zero-width controls, no Devanagari/Arabic-only yeh/kaf/teh-marbuta (same regexes as ur-activation.test.mjs), no ASCII . ? , after Urdu, no English stub
method.bidi: all 143 values rendered with realistic arguments and run through fribidi --rtl --nopad --nobreak --clean; /word and $word tokens checked for sigil side; candidate fixes (LRM before sigil, FSI/PDI around token) re-run
method.glossary: each term grepped across the 8093 shipped ur values outside these five namespaces
method.gates: node --test scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs 44/44 pass; node scripts/i18n/context-parity.mjs ok; node --test scripts/i18n/ur-activation.test.mjs 3/3 pass (but its bundledCatalogues.ur holds only the 8093 shipped values: keys.gen.ts is not regenerated for the new files, so that scan does not yet cover these 143 values; the same regexes were run directly on them: 0 hits)

bidi_decision.lrm_in_catalogue: NO. Evidence: (1) scripts/i18n/ur-activation.test.mjs MANUAL_BIDI rejects U+200E/U+200F/U+2066-2069 in any ur value, so an LRM would fail the repo gate; (2) an LRM only repairs a sigil written in the catalogue string (18 keys), not a sigil that arrives inside a placeholder value (8 keys), which needs FSI/PDI at the call site (precedent hub-skills-library.tsx ui.hub.skills.local_path); (3) 24 shipped ur values already carry the same pattern with no controls; (4) an LRM at string start flips a dir=auto container to LTR.
bidi_decision.rendered_defect: In a dir=rtl paragraph a '/' or '$' that follows Urdu text (or opens the string) resolves to the RTL embedding level and paints on the far side of the Latin word: '/stop' is shown as 'stop/', '$name' as 'name$'. fribidi --rtl: '/model نہیں چل سکی: x' -> visual 'x :ﯽﮑﺳ ﻞﭼ ﮟﯿﮩﻧ model/'. '/move <path>' as a value is shown as '<move <path/' (the closing > is mirrored to <). Both fixes verified: LRM before the sigil gives '/model'; FSI/PDI around a value gives '/move <path>'. After Latin text ('Enter /goal') nothing is wrong.
bidi_decision.recommendation: Ship the ur bytes unchanged. Fix in code, not in ur bytes: wrap value placeholders that carry a command (example, sentence, cap, scope) in U+2068..U+2069 at the call site; for the 18 literal-slash messages either pass the slash inside the value (en change, all locales) or add a renderer step for dir=rtl locales that inserts U+200E before a '/' or '$' that precedes a Latin letter or '{'. Not done here: audit is read-only.

findings.proposed: text unchanged; isolate in code (see bidi_decision)
findings.reason: A literal '/' or '$' in the catalogue string follows Urdu or opens the string, so under dir=rtl it paints after the word ('model/'). Not fixable in ur bytes (gate forbids controls); same class as 24 shipped ur values.

findings.proposed: text unchanged; wrap the value in U+2068..U+2069 at the call site
findings.reason: The value carries its own sigil or brackets; unisolated after Urdu it paints '<move <path/', 'Z⌘', 'src/~'. FSI/PDI fixes it exactly (rendered).
